Security Operations Analyst - Vireo Networks

About the role
Vireo Networks provides managed network services and runs a 24-hour security operations centre. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Monitor and triage security alerts
- Investigate and respond to incidents
- Tune detection rules

Requirements
- SIEM monitoring
- Incident response
- Threat hunting
- Python scripting
- Network security fundamentals

Nice to have
- Cloud security
- Forensics

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
